'''2000 AugustaCon Constructed (Day 1)''' was a Star Wars CCG convention constructed tournament held at AugustaCon, Augusta, Georgia in October 2000. It is known from Landon Sommer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1385">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loserd1385/ 2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loser], DeckTech (Landon "Periculum" Sommer, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loserd1385/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 2000
* '''Site:''' AugustaCon, Augusta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 24
